ABOUT_SDL_TEXT: The idea of founding the political party “Serbian Democratic League” arose from an initiative of several distinguished people from various parts of Macedonia. The idea began to take shape on 20 January, with the start of collecting the 1,000 notarized statements required by law to form a new political party that would take the historic name “Serbian Democratic League”, a name that first appeared in the Ottoman Empire. The entire signature collection was completed on 15 February, on the feast of the Presentation of the Lord (Sretenje). Once the signature collection was finished, the initiators began all administrative procedures and confirmed all required acts at the founding assembly. After all legal procedures were completed, the party was finally registered with the competent court and the Central Registry, thereby formally beginning its activities.
MISSION_VISION_ITEM_1: The purpose of organizing within the political party Serbian Democratic League is to improve, within the framework of all legal regulations, the position of the Serbian people, who are indigenous to this region. Across all spheres of social life, we aim to improve the status of Serbs living in the Republic of North Macedonia.
MISSION_VISION_ITEM_2: Our members, working in the party’s sectors and commissions, will contribute concrete solutions for improving the system we live in through their proposals and ideas.
MISSION_VISION_P1: Our vision is a successful Macedonia, where the people of the Republic enjoy a high standard of living and fulfil their potential in an economy that is sustainable, competitive and offers equal opportunities for all.
MISSION_VISION_P2: Our vision is for institutions to be efficient, accountable and accessible, responsible, innovative and open to citizen participation. We want the community we live in to be green, safe and resilient to all contemporary risks and threats. We want an infrastructurally connected and digitalized country.
MISSION_VISION_P3: We want to create conditions that help build a foundation for prosperous young people, for individuals who are fulfilled, happy and healthy, and for people who age actively.
MISSION_VISION_P4: Art and culture are the pillars of our society and contribute to improving collective well-being and the international perception of the country.
MISSION_VISION_P5: Our country is an active and respected member of international organizations and regional initiatives, where it promotes values, norms and processes that result in a better life for all people.
